The flat also has air conditioning, heat pump, PVC frames with double glazing, electric shutters, lift and parking space.

 Located in a quiet residential area, a few minutes from Aveiro and Praia da Barra, close to shops, services, schools and transport.

 An excellent opportunity for those looking for a modern, comfortable T3 with a truly differentiating outdoor space.
